title: Canonical derived scalar-change relation for supported Kummer classes
statement: Use the schemes, closed supported constants, concrete finite twist and supported Ext classes of [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]. Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings killed by the same exponent $N$. Use exact restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] on the ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For module sheaves $F$ over $R$ and $G$ over $S$, define the predicate that $\eta:F\to\operatorname{Res}_\varphi G$ is a derived scalar-extension unit to mean that, for every unbounded derived $S$-object $K$, the canonical map $\operatorname{Hom}(G[0],K)\to\operatorname{Hom}(F[0],\operatorname{Res}_\varphi K)$ given by $g\mapsto\operatorname{Res}_\varphi(g)\circ\eta[0]$ is bijective. This specifies the value of derived tensor extension [def-kun-derived-tensor] [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] by its adjunction. For supported classes $c_R$ and $c_S$, define their normalized derived scalar-extension relation to require maps $\eta:R_D\to\operatorname{Res}_\varphi S_D$ and $\theta:R_T(1)\to\operatorname{Res}_\varphi S_T(1)$ sending local constants $r$ to $\varphi(r)$ and local pure root tensors $r\otimes z$ to $\varphi(r)\otimes z$. Require $i_*\eta$ and $\theta$ to satisfy the preceding derived universal property, and require the Ext square $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi(c_S)\circ i_*\eta=\theta[2]\circ c_R$. No flatness of $S$ over $R$ is assumed.

Retain the generator clauses, the two scalar-unit requirements and the Ext square in SupportedKummerScalar unchanged. Select the proved scalarWeakSheafify instance locally when elaborating the unchanged generator clauses. HasWeakSheafify is a proposition, so this proof selection changes no sheafification data.
